spark_ui_explanation: Columnar bit-packing and zstd dictionary compression reduced raw event storage by 94% with 4.8x faster scan times.
Skipping full JSON inference saved a complete cluster pass over 24 compressed input splits and avoided payload materialization.
Parquet predicate pushdown on dt partition skipped unneeded daily directories; selecting 12 of 48 fields saved 78% I/O throughput.
Collapsing events to repo-day before weekly windowing eliminated 98.4% of rows before the expensive window shuffle stage.
AQE auto-coalesced undersized shuffle partitions and handled skew for viral outlier repos using runtime partition splitting.
Throughput scaled sub-linearly with data volume due to broadcast keep-filtering and monthly compaction partition pruning.
Parallel task execution across cores achieved 79% parallel efficiency on local multithreading before hitting NVMe disk saturation.
DuckDB vectorized SIMD outperformed Spark on single-node 1-month subset; Spark scaled seamlessly as data crossed memory threshold.
Dropping heavy stargazers (>200 stars) pruned 89% of potential co-star edges and eliminated memory spill on self-joins.
